{"absolute_url":"https://boards.greenhouse.io/purestorage/jobs/7510960?gh_jid=7510960","data_compliance":[{"type":"gdpr","requires_consent":false,"requires_processing_consent":false,"requires_retention_consent":false,"retention_period":null,"demographic_data_consent_applies":false}],"education":"education_optional","internal_job_id":3329344,"location":{"name":"Amsterdam, Netherlands"},"metadata":[{"id":37087123,"name":"Cost Center","value":"21220 EMEA North Netherlands Sales","value_type":"single_select"}],"id":7510960,"updated_at":"2026-01-07T12:51:10-05:00","requisition_id":"16501","title":"Account Executive, Enterprise (Netherlands)","company_name":"Pure Storage","first_published":"2026-01-07T12:51:10-05:00","language":"en","content":"<div class="content-intro"><p>We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>As an Account Executive, you'll be a key player in expanding our market presence and driving new business growth predominantly within the Enterprise sector in The Netherlands. You will lead the full sales cycle, from prospecting to close, and be the primary point of contact for our most strategic accounts. This role is a unique opportunity to directly impact our business by building strong relationships with both customers and partners and championing our innovative solutions to solve complex business challenges.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Lead the full sales cycle</strong> for our enterprise solutions, directing pursuit teams and executing strategic account plans to secure new customer acquisition and expand existing relationships.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Drive revenue growth</strong> by actively prospecting, building a robust pipeline, and consistently exceeding your sales quotas.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Develop and maintain strong relationships</strong> with key customers, ensuring high satisfaction and positioning Pure Storage as a trusted advisor and long-term partner.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Collaborate closely with our channel partners</strong> to leverage their networks and expertise, positioning our solutions effectively within the market and maximizing sales opportunities.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Proven sales experience</strong> in a direct and indirect sales environment with enterprise accounts, with a track record of exceeding quotas.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Expertise in prospecting,</strong> account planning, and relationship building with key stakeholders at all levels of an organization.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Experience working with channel partners</strong> and a strong understanding of how to leverage these relationships to drive sales and market penetration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>A deep understanding of the storage industry,</strong> cloud computing, and modern data center architecture.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Fluency in Dutch & English.</strong></p>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pure Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Pure Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been Named Fortune's Best Large Workplaces in the Bay Area™, Fortune's Best Workplaces for Millennials™ and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Pure Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://purebenefits.com">purebenefits.com</a> for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.<br> <br>Pure is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.<br><br></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>JOIN US AND BRING YOUR BEST.</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>BRING YOUR BOLD.</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>BRING YOUR FLASH.</strong></p></div>","departments":[{"id":61522,"name":"Sales","child_ids":[],"parent_id":null}],"offices":[{"id":14351,"name":"Office - Amsterdam","location":"Amsterdam, Netherlands","child_ids":[],"parent_id":43806}]}
